assessment: Many of us have followed the work of your group and others on FGF23 excess and hyperphosphatemia and the morbidity of chronic kidney disease in both animal models and in the human disease state. Inflammation, anemia and muscle wasting are clearcut serious consequences to deal with CKD. Animal models that will allow us to further elucidate the signaling and effector pathways activated by hyperphosphatemia are welcome advances in the field.
